items.name: split-hover
items.title: Split Hover
items.description: Splits text into characters and animates stacked layers on hover for a seamless swap. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

items.name: split-reveal
items.title: Split Reveal
items.description: Masks text and reveals lines, words, or characters on mount or scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: mode
props.description: How to split the text for reveal animation.

props.name: delay
props.description: Initial delay in seconds before animation starts (not for scroll-triggered).

props.name: trigger-on-scroll
props.description: Whether to trigger reveal when element scrolls into view.

props.name: scroll-element
props.description: CSS selector for scrollable container (defaults to window).

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration in seconds (0 = auto based on mode).

props.name: stagger
props.description: Stagger delay between split items in seconds (0 = auto based on mode).

items.name: stacking-words
items.title: Stacking Words
items.description: Splits text into lines and slides each line's words in from the right on scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.ts";
---

<motion-stacking-words
  text="Every word arrives on its own."
  start="top 90%"
  end="top 30%"
></motion-stacking-words>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-stacking-words
    text="Every word arrives on its own."
    start="top 90%"
    end="top 30%"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-stacking-words
  text="Every word arrives on its own."
  start="top 90%"
  end="top 30%"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.js"></script>

<motion-stacking-words
  text="Every word arrives on its own."
  start="top 90%"
  end="top 30%"
></motion-stacking-words>

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: start
props.description: ScrollTrigger start position (when animation begins).

props.name: end
props.description: ScrollTrigger end position (when animation completes).

props.name: scrub
props.description: Scrub duration in seconds for smooth scroll linking.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between each word's animation in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: easing function for the animation.

props.name: scroll-element
props.description: CSS selector for scrollable container (defaults to window).

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: Cycles through an array of text strings with a blurred vertical slide transition. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: texts
props.description: Array of strings to cycle through. Pass as a JSON array string.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between transitions.

items.name: text-repel
items.title: Text Repel
items.description: Splits text into words or characters that repel from the pointer. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/text-repel-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-text-repel text="Hover over me" mode="words" />
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether to split by words or characters.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum distance in pixels to repel text elements.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius around the cursor where repel effect is active.

props.name: falloff-power
props.description: Power curve for falloff (higher = sharper falloff).

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: easing function for the animation.

props.name: hover-target
props.description: CSS selector for an external hover target. Defaults to this element.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Scrambles characters on hover before settling back to the original text. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and scramble.

props.name: hover-target
props.description: CSS selector for an external element that triggers the effect. Defaults to this element.

props.name: scramble-duration
props.description: Duration of the scramble animation in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between each character's animation in seconds.

props.name: cycles
props.description: Number of random character cycles before settling.

props.name: characters
props.description: Character pool to use for scrambling effect.

items.name: weight-wave
items.title: Weight Wave
items.description: Hover-reactive text effect that smoothly increases font weight with a falloff across neighboring characters. Requires a variable font.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: base-weight
props.description: Base font weight when not hovering.

props.name: hover-weight
props.description: Font weight at cursor position.

props.name: influence-radius
props.description: Number of neighboring characters affected by the wave.

props.name: falloff-power
props.description: Power curve for weight falloff (higher = sharper falloff).

props.name: duration
props.description: Animation duration in seconds.

props.name: ease
props.description: easing function for the animation.
